text:
[Council File 26-1389]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Personal Services Contracts with USA Waste of California, Inc., for recycling and/or disposal services of clean and mixed inert debris, clean and mixed construction and demolition debris, bulky items, white goods, and mixed debris.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works (BPW) to execute the revised Personal Services Contracts with USA Waste of California, Inc. dba Waste Management; Arakelian Enterprises, Inc. dba Athens Services; California Waste Services, LLC, and Cordova Rentals, Inc. dba Cordova Construction Services for the Recycling and/or Disposal Services of Clean and Mixed Inert Debris, Clean and Mixed Construction and Demolition Debris, Bulky Items, White Goods, and Mixed Debris with a revised term of five years with one five-year renewal option.
2. AUTHORIZE the President, BPW, or two members, to execute said contracts.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The BPW reports that the combined estimated annual usage across all four contracts varies annually but could be up to $14 million. Sufficient funds for Fiscal Year 2025-26 are available within Fund No. 100/86, Account No. 003040 entitled Contractual Services. Funds and appropriations for future fiscal years are not yet identified and existing appropriations may change based on available cash balances. Therefore, future funds and appropriations will be determined by the Director and General Manager of Bureau of Street Services. The City’s liability under these contracts shall only be to the extent of the present City appropriation to fund the contracts. However, if the City shall appropriate funds for any succeeding years, the City’s liability shall be extended to the extent of such appropriation, subject to the terms and conditions of the contracts.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 28, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026
summary: Board of Public Works request to approve revised contracts with USA Waste of California to recycle or dispose of debris, bulky items and other waste.
